title: 東京大賞典の後に・トップウマドル☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon wins the Tokyo Daishoten. Her concert proves to be such a hit that all her fans can't fit inside the venue, and staff need to set up a screen outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the middle of the performance, the lights suddenly dim…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the screen lights up with a surprise video showing messages of gratitude from all of Smart Falcon's loving fans—starting with none other than Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Emotions run high. It appears the concert is going to wrap up there with a happy ending, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Like a true Umadol, Smart Falcon requests another chant from the crowd! Tonight, a top Umadol is born!
